text: The Transition Lead, CreateTO and the Head, Legal and Corporate Secretary, CreateTO, will give a presentation on the status of the Rail Deck Park project.

The Board of Directors of CreateTO: 1. Requested The Transition Lead, CreateTO to consult with the Environment and Energy Division and the City Planning Division to communicate the Board's request that any opportunities to achieve the City's CO2 targets and generate income be pursued with respect to the development of Raildeck park, and report back to the Board when appropriate.
